status: Exploratory post-review amendment; prior results and preliminary label audit seen
known_before_amendment: Preliminary patient linkage found 47 eligible original negatives with recorded ICU entry in another admission within 24h; no corresponding new timed hospital deaths
analysis: Fixed-model endpoint sensitivity; no retraining or new independent validation
primary_endpoint_unchanged: ICU or hospital death linked to the index ED admission within 24h; original eligible ED death upper-bound proxies retained
sensitivity_endpoint: Original positives OR any ICU entry OR recorded hospital death for the same subject_id in the inclusive 0-24h window after ED arrival, regardless of hadm_id
ascertainment_scope: Events recorded within the available single-hospital database only; no ascertainment of other hospitals or unrecorded deaths
eligibility: Original primary eligible encounters and original A/T/G memberships; 13 contradictory death chronologies and 4 indeterminate index death windows remain excluded
frame_estimand: Original encounter populations; patient bootstrap accommodates repeated ED visits and events qualifying for multiple encounters
clinical_utility: ESI3, fixed 5% alert budget, fractional allocation at tied scores; unchanged model scores, reranked within each resample
interpretation: Isolates sensitivity of performance estimates to label scope; models were trained on original labels and are not newly optimized for the expanded endpoint
